facts.value: The information regarding the TOEFL test applies to the internet-based test. Please note that a 'MyBest Scores' result is not accepted.
Please take the TOEFL at a test center, as many of our partner universities do not accept the TOEFL Home Edition.
No proof through the Abitur certificate is accepted unless it is explicitly stated in the certificate that you have unrestricted access to foreign universities with the language acquisition.
If B2 is indicated, you can apply with proof from the Department (B2.1 or B2.2) or an equivalent to the DAAD test.
Please note that changes in the university-specific information on language requirements cannot be ruled out, so please check the information regularly.

If you do not speak the local language of the destination country, it is recommended to acquire basic knowledge of the corresponding language where possible. However, this is not a prerequisite for application!
If multiple language requirements are listed (e.g., B2/TOEFL/IELTS), these are to be understood as alternatives, meaning you only need to submit proof of one of them.

Please check the course offerings in your desired language beyond the information provided here and note that at some universities, only a few English-language courses may be offered or only master's courses may be chosen.
It is not ruled out that you will study with a planned business focus at a 'School of Economics'. Please check the teaching offerings in this regard.
